summary: A unit an interval can be expressed in.
description: `"millisecond"`, `"second"`, `"minute"` and `"hour"` are fixed multiples of a millisecond. `"day"`, `"month"` and `"year"` are calendar units with no fixed length: a day is 23 or 25 hours across a daylight-saving change, and a month is anything from 28 to 31 days.
Which of the two a function applies is stated on its own page — `diff` counts whole calendar units, `offset` moves by them and clamps the day of the month where it has to.
